summary_rationale: AXISCADES possesses defensible engineering and defense electronics moats anchored by Mistral Solutions (sole-source DRDO Ashwini radar SDPUs and AI counter-drone systems), tier-1 aerospace certifications (AS9100D, CEMILAC), and a transformative ~$237M divestment of low-margin linear services to Akkodis. However, business quality is rated CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL rather than an unconstrained compounder due to acute FY26 working capital absorption (debtor days stretching to 130 days), negative FY26 operating cash flow (-₹1 Cr) and free cash flow (-₹135 Cr), modest 3-year average ROE (10.8%), recent executive leadership transitions, and integration risks across Cloud Wave, XiDA/ITSJ, and Devanahalli Aero Land. KPI health is PASS_WITH_WATCH pending verified cash conversion recovery and post-divestment debt paydown.
